plan.failureSummary: The application's chatbot failed to generate any assistant responses to user queries, making it impossible to evaluate topic compliance.
observedIndicators: page.ai flow stopped with rationale indicating chatbot failed to generate assistant responses to user queries.
Failure screenshot shows user messages rendered in chat without any corresponding assistant responses.
Flow history shows a current failure streak of 9 consecutive runs (pass rate 33.3%).

remediationSteps.summary: Investigate and fix chatbot backend/LLM response generation on briefcase.chat.
remediationSteps.details: Check backend API integration, LLM provider connectivity, and error logs for briefcase.chat to restore chatbot response generation.

remediationSteps.summary: Re-run automation suite after backend fix.
remediationSteps.details: Re-run the conversational bot compliance test once backend response generation has been restored.

additionalDataRequests.description: Backend application logs and network request/response traces for briefcase.chat during message submission.

plan.notes: The autonomous AI agent correctly determined that the objective could not be completed because briefcase.chat backend failed to render or stream assistant responses to user messages. Historical data shows 9 consecutive failures, indicating a persistent backend regression.
